body: I notice my reflection, garbled and distorted, barely visible against the glass. The world around me appears distant, as if through a foggy mirror. My heartbeat quickens, an instinctive call for protection. I reach out tentatively, fingers brushing across the surface of the glass. The coldness stings but ignites a primal urge to protect.
